{{Codex|Narin's signature pistols strike with winter's chilling bite. Reloading creates a cloud of freezing mist that inflicts Cold Status Effect on enemies that enter it and expands per round reloaded.}}
'''Aksondol''' are {{WF|Narin|Narin's}} [[Signature Weapon|signature]] [[Dual Pistols]], which on reload, emit a blast that inflicts {{D|Cold}} [[Status Effect]] per round expended.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals {{D|Cold}} and {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*Upon reloading, the weapon emits a blast that inflicts {{D|Cold}} status procs scaled at a 1:1 ratio (1m blast radius per 1 status proc) based on the number of rounds expended; this effect can be further increased using mods such as {{M|Slip Magazine}}.
**Blast requires [[line of sight]] to inflict status procs.
**Blast radius '''does''' scale with {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}) and [[Magazine Size]].
**Blast wave's {{D|Cold}} and Freeze status effects are affected by mods to [[Status Duration]]. 
**Blast is centered on the wielder's position at the beginning of the reload.
***Despite the blast wave visually traveling for about 1 second, it applies instantly to enemies in range and has no lingering field.
**Blast cannot be refreshed by cancelling reload. Once a blast has occurred, another blast will not occur until a manual reload of Aksondol has been completed. 
**Blast will not trigger off passive reloads from mods such as {{M|Eject Magazine}}.

==Acquisition==
Aksondol's blueprints can be purchased from [[Cephalon Melica]] on [[Yuvan Peak]], [[Earth]], or the [[Chrysalith]], [[Zariman Ten Zero]], for {{Resource|Entropic Kuva}}, which are dropped by [[Entropic Eximus]] in the Zariman.

The main blueprint costs {{Resource|Entropic Kuva|200}}, while the barrel and receiver blueprints cost {{Resource|Entropic Kuva|30}} each and the link blueprint costs {{Resource|Entropic Kuva|60}}, requiring {{Resource|Entropic Kuva|380}} total.

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*Status duration mods {{M|Perpetual Agony}} and {{M|Augur Seeker}} increase the duration of {{D|Cold}} and Freeze effects, including from the reload blast, resulting in a combined 8.4 seconds of Frozen effect on enemies and 16.8 seconds of {{D|Cold}}. 
*The reload blast radius can be increased by using magazine size mods and Fulmination mods.
**With {{M|Primed Fulmination}}, {{M|Primed Slip Magazine}}, {{M|Tainted Clip}} and {{M|Ice Storm}}, Aksondol has a magazine size of 20, and a reload blast radius of about 28.8 meters. 
*The {{D|Cold}} and Freeze effects applied by the Aksondol's reload does not count as inflicting a status effect for the purposes of {{M|Shivering Contagion}}, or {{Arcane|Cascadia Empowered}}.
**Although {{Arcane|Secondary Encumber}} does count it, Encumber's limit of 1 bonus proc per tick significantly limits its synergy, as the blast wave's effects all occur within one tick. 
**The blast wave has no interaction with {{Arcane|Primary Frostbite}}, although Aksondol's weapon fire can trigger it if {{D|Cold}} is a final element.
*The blast wave can trigger {{Arcane|Arcane Ice Storm}} if it applies enough Cold to Freeze an enemy.
**As Aksondol's default magazine size is 8, either enemies must have 2 or more pre-existing Cold statuses, or a magazine size mod with a bonus of at least +20% must be equipped, for it to trigger Arcane Ice Storm.

== Bugs ==

* If the reload blast is triggered while [[Gyre]]'s [[Arcsphere]] is deployed nearby, it will be unable to hit enemies based on the position of the player and the enemy relative to the sphere's location. If both the player and enemy are inside it will hit, if one is inside and the other is on the outside, it will not hit the enemy.

==Trivia==
*Aksondol is named after Son Dol (손돌), a historical/legendary Korean ferryman who was unjustly executed and whose spirit brings violent, cold wind annually.
